discovery.//: TE15 R7.1.3 discovery-tree parity. Each leg materializes the same tree into its own sandbox user-agent dir: upstream substitutes `<CFGDIR>` with `.pi`, rpi with `.rpi`, and both normalize the config-dir segment back to `<CFGDIR>`. `linked-nested`/`cycle` symlinks are created on both legs on non-Windows platforms only (materialize.json records the same limitation). Scope is `user` on both sides so builtin catalogs do not participate.

notify.//: TE17 (R7.1.7.2) completion-notice cases. `format` feeds the upstream-shaped details to formatSingleCompletion on both legs; the Rust leg maps childRuns[0].runId to its single-run run_id. The `Saved output:` line is an rpi-only addition (upstream carries saved paths inside childOutputs blocks / preview text) and therefore NOT part of the byte-comparable slice - it is covered by crate unit tests. `parse` cases assert the shared parse projection (runId from childRuns[0]).
